item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q018_tal_effector_repeat_lengths","answer":"In the current SCOPe release 2.08, all three are domains in family a.298.1.1, “TAL (transcription activator-like) effector” (SUNID 267609): d2kq5a_ is PthA, d3v6pa_ is dHax3, and d4cj9a_ is BurrH. Their SCOPe sequences are 51, 373, and 752 residues, respectively. The length difference mainly reflects different numbers of tandem, approximately 34-residue TAL-like repeats, plus differences in terminal or flanking segments; family assignment follows homology and the conserved alpha-helical repeat unit/array architecture, not a narrow total-length cutoff. The classification hierarchy is family a.298.1.1 within the TAL effector-like superfamily a.298.1, the left-handed alpha-alpha superhelix fold a.298, and the all-alpha class a. Family-level co-classification is stronger evolutionary evidence than sharing only a superfamily or fold, but it establishes homology principally at the repeat-module level—not one-to-one orthology or equivalence of the complete proteins. Repeat-variable residues and repeat order/count can change DNA recognition, so DNA targets, host targets, and detailed functions must not be transferred solely from one member to another. Likewise, a structure may template the conserved repeat geometry, but full-array modeling should use a template with a comparable repeat count and terminal context; the short d2kq5a_ fragment is not a representative full-length template for d4cj9a_. Representative selection should therefore match the intended repeat number, sequence pattern, protein context, and structural coverage rather than choosing one family member as universally representative.","evidence_used":["/api/v1/","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d2kq5a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d3v6pa_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/d4cj9a_","/api/v1/releases/2.08/resolve/a.298.1.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/264989","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267704","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267705","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267706","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267645","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267646","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267647","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267609","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d2kq5a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d3v6pa_?release=2.08","/api/v1/sequences/sids/d4cj9a_?release=2.08","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267596","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/267589","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/46456"]}]}
